name: Crowcore
summary: Crowcore is sometimes used as an alternative to Goblincore, which has been criticized as anti-Semitic [ 1 ] , but which shares the value of collecting small, lost, broken, thrown away, or conventionally trivial objects, and nature visuals.
description:
Crowcore is sometimes used as an alternative to Goblincore, which has been criticized as anti-Semitic [ 1 ] , but which shares the value of collecting small, lost, broken, thrown away, or conventionally trivial objects, and nature visuals.

There is significant Tumblr cross-tagging between Crowcore, Gremlincore, Cottagecore, Cottagegore , and various other related aesthetics.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Simplicity, intelligence, freedom, and shiny things
